name: code comment: ISO 4217简码 constraint: UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: symbol comment: 币种符号 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: decimal_precision comment: 小数精度 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 启停状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: exchange_rate_source comment: 汇率数据源 note: '' columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: name comment: 数据源名称 constraint: UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: api_url comment: API地址 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: api_key comment: API密钥(加密) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: priority comment: 优先级(主/备) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fetch_interval comment: 拉取间隔(秒) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 启停状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: last_fetch_at comment: 最近拉取时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: last_fetch_status comment: 最近拉取状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: exchange_rate_raw comment: 原始汇率 note: 'UK: base + target + fetched_at; 直接采集仅USD→X; 派生记录source_id为空' columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: source_id comment: 数据源(派生为空) constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: base_currency_id comment: 基准币种 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: target_currency_id comment: 目标币种 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: source_type comment: 来源(直接采集/派生) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: market_rate comment: 中间价 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fetched_at comment: 采集/计算时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: expires_at comment: 失效时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态(正常/异常) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: spread_rule comment: 点差规则 note: '全局: base+target=NULL; 方向点差覆盖全局; UK: base+target' columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: base_currency_id comment: 基准币种(空=全局) constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: target_currency_id comment: 目标币种(空=全局) constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: spread_rate comment: 点差比例(如0.02) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: priority comment: 优先级 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 启停状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: exchange_rate_published comment: 已发布汇率 note: 'UK: base + target; 同一有向币种对仅一条生效; 币种停用后置为 disabled_by_currency' columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: base_currency_id comment: 基准币种 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: target_currency_id comment: 目标币种 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: market_rate comment: 中间价(含派生) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: source_type comment: 来源(直接/逆向/交叉) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: spread_rate comment: 应用的点差 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: published_rate comment: 平台汇率 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: publish_type comment: 发布方式(定时/手动) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: published_by comment: 发布人(系统/运营) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: published_at comment: 发布时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态(生效/已替换/停用) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: rate_change_log comment: 汇率变动日志 note: '操作类型: 定时发布/手动发布/设置固定汇率/回滚/点差调整/币种停用; 同批次发布共享 batch_id' columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: snapshot_batch_id comment: 发布批次号(可空) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: target_currency_id comment: 目标币种 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: operation_type comment: 操作类型 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: old_rate comment: 变更前汇率 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: new_rate comment: 变更后汇率 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: change_reason comment: 变更原因 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: operator comment: 操作人 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 操作时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: relations: - from: exchange_rate_raw to: exchange_rate_source type: N:1 label: 来源 color: '#d97706' penwidth: 1.4 - from: exchange_rate_raw to: currency type: N:1 label: 基准/目标币种 color: '#6b7280' penwidth: 1.2 - from: spread_rule to: currency type: N:1 label: 基准/目标币种(可空) color: '#2563eb' penwidth: 1.2 style: dashed - from: exchange_rate_published to: currency type: N:1 label: 基准/目标币种 color: '#4f46e5' penwidth: 1.4 - from: exchange_rate_published to: exchange_rate_raw type: N:1 label: 加工来源 color: '#2563eb' penwidth: 1.2 style: dashed - from: exchange_rate_published to: spread_rule type: N:1 label: 应用点差 color: '#2563eb' style: dashed - from: rate_change_log to: currency type: N:1 label: 目标币种 color: '#dc2626' - from: rate_change_log to: exchange_rate_published type: N:1 label: 关联发布记录 color: '#dc2626' penwidth: 1.2 style: dashed design_rules: naming_alignment: 实体名、字段名与产品架构图保持一致 currency_external: currency 实体来自币种管理模块，本模块只引用不创建 raw_uniqueness: exchange_rate_raw 唯一键 (base_currency_id, target_currency_id, fetched_at)；直接采集仅 USD→X，派生记录 source_id 为空 spread_rule_global: spread_rule 中 base/target 同时为空表示全局点差；方向点差按 priority 覆盖全局 published_active_one: 同一有向币种对在 exchange_rate_published 中仅一条 status=active；币种停用时批量置为 disabled_by_currency rate_change_log_batch: 同一次发布批次的多币种变动共享 snapshot_batch_id，便于回滚整批
